subject: Stratus AI — account activation & PO structure details
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Emma Zhang <emma@stratus.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-04T09:13:00-07:00
Subject: Stratus AI — account activation & PO structure details

Hi Emma,

Welcome — excited to get Stratus activated as a Redwood vendor. Before we open a PO and push this through finance, a few items we need to confirm so the purchase order matches both sides' systems and avoids delays: 

Required vendor data (please confirm exact values):
- Legal entity name (as it should appear on the PO)
- Tax ID / EIN (W-9 attached if available)
- Remit-to address and remit-to email for invoices
- Bank wiring instructions (if you accept wires)
- Invoice cadence (monthly / quarterly / milestone) and payment terms (e.g., Net30)

PO formatting and line-item guidance:
- Preferred line-item breakdown: subscription SKU / usage SKU / one-time setup / support (please specify names and any SKU codes)
- For each line item we need: SKU (optional), description (short), unit price, quantity, unit of measure (e.g., seat, GB), extended total, and GL/cost-center mapping if you require it on the PO
- Do you require a separate line for taxes / VAT or do you prefer tax to be handled on the invoice?

Timeline/questions for activation: 
- We typically issue the PO 24–48 business hours after we receive a completed vendor form + W-9 and confirmation of billing contact. Does that timeline work?
- Any special contract or SOW that must be referenced on the PO? If yes, provide link or DocuSign envelope id.
- Do you require a vendor onboarding questionnaire or security attestation before we start billing?

Attachments we can send from our side: sample PO template, vendor onboarding checklist, and Redwood’s standard payment terms.

Can you return the completed vendor form and the W-9 (if available) and confirm the exact legal name to use on the PO? If possible, please also attach a sample invoice that shows your preferred line-item labels so we can mirror it.

If anything on our side requires review (SOW referencing special billing conditions), loop in your legal contact.

Thanks — aiming to have a PO into your AP inbox within 48 hours of receiving the completed forms.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Procurement Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachments: (will attach Redwood vendor form / sample PO once I have your remit info)
From: Emma Zhang <emma@stratus.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: procurements@stratus.ai
Date: 2027-04-04T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Stratus AI — account activation & PO structure details

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the clear list — appreciate the checklist. I attached our completed vendor form and a current W-9, plus a sample invoice so you can see how we typically present line items. Quick answers inline below: 

- Legal entity: Stratus AI, Inc. (exactly as on W-9)
- EIN: 12-3456789 (in W-9)
- Remit-to address: 1010 Nimbus Way, Suite 200, San Mateo, CA 94401
- Invoice email (AP): ap@stratus.ai
- Bank (wires): Stratus AI, Inc. / Bank of West / Routing 111000025 / Account 123456789
- Invoice cadence: Monthly, with prorated first invoice if start date is mid-month
- Payment terms: Net30 (we can be flexible for enterprise deals)

Preferred line-item structure: we usually supply two lines per month: 1) SaaS subscription (SKU: STR-SUB-MON) — description: platform subscription, unit = month; 2) Usage overage (SKU: STR-USG) — description: overage charges billed monthly. For SOW-based work (professional services) we supply separate invoices with the SOW reference.

We do not require a separate tax line on the PO — taxes are on the invoice. We also included a sample invoice named Sample_Invoice_Stratus.pdf.

Attachments: Stratus_Vendor_Form.xlsx; W-9_Stratus.pdf; Sample_Invoice_Stratus.pdf

Let us know if you need the SOW referenced on the PO — we can provide a DocuSign id for the signed SOW.

Best,
Emma Zhang
Head of Revenue Operations
Stratus AI
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Emma Zhang <emma@stratus.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-05T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Stratus AI — account activation & PO structure details

Thanks Emma — that’s very helpful. Two quick clarifications from finance/procurement before we create the PO: 

1) Legal name: please confirm that the W-9 file name and the entity in the header match exactly. If the legal name contains punctuation or a DBA, we need the canonical version for the PO.
2) Line-item handling: we prefer a single subscription line on the PO with a note that usage will be invoiced as separate lines monthly. If you require the SKU fields filled, confirm the exact SKU string we should include (we’ll map to our internal product codes).
3) Cost center: Marissa, can you confirm the deal’s cost center and GL that finance should use? Marissa, please add the HubSpot record id and estimate ARR for the PO header.

Procurement timing: once we have the completed vendor form, W-9, and a confirmed legal name, Finance typically issues the PO within 48 business hours. If the SOW needs to be referenced on the PO, include the DocuSign envelope id — we’ll put it in the PO notes.

Emma, can you confirm whether Stratus requires PO acknowledgement (PDF) back to your AP inbox or if a simple PDF PO sent to ap@stratus.ai is sufficient?

Warmly,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Manager, Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference

Emma — thanks for the fast turnaround and the attachments. Recap and next steps so everyone is aligned: 

Confirmed items:
- Legal entity: Stratus AI, Inc. (matches attached W-9)
- AP email: ap@stratus.ai; remit-to address and bank details received
- Preferred line items: one subscription line (STR-SUB-MON) + usage/overage lines billed monthly; professional services invoiced separately with SOW ref
- Payment terms: Net30; taxes handled on invoice

What we need from Stratus (action for your AP/procurement team):
- Return the signed vendor form (Stratus_Vendor_Form.xlsx) with bank wiring info completed (if different from attached)
- If you want the SOW referenced on the PO, please provide the DocuSign envelope id or the SOW file name (we can put it in the PO notes)

What Redwood will do: 
- Marissa will publish the HubSpot record and confirm cost center/GL for the PO header (Marissa: please add the record link to the deal).
- Finance intends to create and send the PO PDF to ap@stratus.ai by 2027-04-08T17:00:00-07:00, assuming the completed vendor form + W-9 are returned today. If any item is missing we may need an extra business day.
- We will attach the SOW reference and our standard payment terms to the PO.

Deliverables/links: 
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/78910
- DocuSign (SOW) placeholder: https://www.docusign.com/recipient?envelopeId=3a7b9c

Attachments included on this thread: Stratus_Vendor_Form.xlsx, W-9_Stratus.pdf, Sample_Invoice_Stratus.pdf, SOW_Stratus_v1.pdf

If that timeline works for you, Emma, I’ll move this to finance and we’ll follow up when the PO is generated. Thanks all for the quick turnaround.
